Petroleum, natural gas, and coal are known as fossil fuels. A fossil fuel is the residue of plants
and animals that buried millions of year ago. Intense pressure and chemical reaction slowly
converted dead plants and animals to fossils fuels that we use today. Fossil fuels are distributed
unevenly around the world andare being used as energy andpower resources.

Scarcityof ElectricityandGas in Pakistan
Pakistan is facing Load shedding and Gas shortages for the last two decades.
Thereareseveralreasonsbehindit.Someoftheseare:
1. The major cause of this issue is increasing demand as the population of the country,
increasing day by day. It requires more electricity and Gas.
There are two sources of electricity, One is natural gas and other is imported oil. We rely
much on natural gas as oil is an expensive source to produce power. But now a days we are
facing shortage of natural gas also which has decreased the capacity of production.
In Pakistan other inexpensive sources of energy like hydropower, wind energy and biomass
are ignored; Govt should take initiatives to install these projects in the country as they are
cheap, durable and reliable.
